_comment: Copy this file to <your-mod-slug>.json and fill it in.
The slug must be lowercase words separated by hyphens, and the filename
must match it: a mod called 'My Cool Mod' lives in my-cool-mod.json.
Fields marked optional can be deleted entirely rather than left blank.
Validate before opening a pull request:  python3 build/community.py
Any key starting with an underscore is ignored, including this one.
name: My Cool Mod
teaser: One sentence describing what the mod does. Shown in the mod list.
_optional: everything below this line can be removed
description_html: A longer description. Basic HTML only: p, ul, li, a, b, i, code, pre, h2, h3, img.
